instruction: Show NIC driver and firmware details with ethtool
Check link speed and duplex with ethtool
Show NIC ring buffer sizes with ethtool
Show NIC offload features with ethtool
Change NIC speed/duplex with ethtool
output: sudo ethtool -s eth0 speed 1000 duplex full autoneg off

instruction: Show NIC statistics counters with ethtool
Identify NIC driver in use with ethtool
Show NIC PCI bus information with ethtool
Show traffic control qdiscs and classes
Add a root HTB qdisc with a 100mbit rate limit
output: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && sudo tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 100mbit

instruction: View all traffic control filters applied to an interface
Show traffic control class statistics
Add a 50ms delay using netem on eth0
output: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 50ms

instruction: Add packet loss of 10% using netem on eth0
output: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 10%

instruction: Add delay with jitter using netem
output: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 50ms 10ms

instruction: Change the qdisc on eth0 to fq_codel for bufferbloat control
output: sudo tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root fq_codel

instruction: Show IP addresses on all interfaces
Show link state of all interfaces
Bring an interface down and up with ip
output: sudo ip link set eth0 down && sudo ip link set eth0 up

instruction: Show the routing table with ip route
Add a default gateway with ip route
output: sudo ip route add default via 192.168.1.1

instruction: Show the ARP/neighbor table with ip neigh
Add a static ARP entry with ip neigh
output: sudo ip neigh add 192.168.1.5 ll aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff dev eth0

instruction: Delete a neighbor entry with ip neigh
output: sudo ip neigh del 192.168.1.5 dev eth0

instruction: Flush all IP addresses from an interface
output: sudo ip addr flush dev eth0
